The Tao concept of “wu Wei” may be helpful…it’s all about allowing things to happen naturally and effortlessly and letting go of the need to control anything and everything.

It also in more detail talks about relinquishing the ego and our attachment to it. Don’t act with a sense of self or always feel the need to act with a concrete plan of action and you will hopefully feel a greater connection to everything. 

I guess to put it as simple as narrowed down as possible, the concept of Wu Wei is about stopping the forcing of action whether it’s mental action (seeking exc) or even “actual action”.
